2026 (MMXXVI) is the current year, and is a common year starting on Thursday of the Gregorian calendar, the 2026th year of the Common Era (CE) and Anno Domini (AD) designations, the 26th  year of the 3rd millennium and the 21st century, and the  7th   year of the 2020s decade.  
The early part of the year saw escalating armed conflicts in the Americas and Middle East. In January, the United States launched a military operation in Venezuela that captured sitting President Nicolás Maduro, leading to a blockade of Venezuelan oil exports that contributed to a crisis in Cuba. In Syria, an offensive by the Syrian government led to the Syrian Democratic Forces eventually being integrated into the Syrian Army, ending the Rojava Revolution, while in Yemen, a counteroffensive by the Yemeni government led to the collapse of the Southern Transitional Council, followed by Houthi offensives, including attacks on airports in Saudi Arabia. In February, Pakistan launched airstrikes against Afghanistan, leading to an open war between both nations. In Iran, in response to authorities cracking down on protests, the United States and Israel began a war in late February with the assassination of Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei, which resulted in widespread economic grief, fuel shortages and retaliatory strikes on Gulf nations, as well as the closure of the Strait of Hormuz and a naval blockade. There were also escalations of the Ethiopian civil conflict.

A quantum computer is a computer that represents and processes information using quantum states. Quantum computations exploit phenomena such as superposition, interference, and entanglement. Quantum computers have the potential to complete some calculations exponentially faster than classical computers. For example, a large-scale quantum computer could break widely used encryption schemes and aid physicists in performing physical simulations. However, current hardware implementations of quantum computation are largely experimental and suitable for only certain specialized tasks.
The basic unit of information in quantum computing, the qubit (quantum bit), serves a similar function as the bit in ordinary or "classical" computing. Unlike a classical bit, which can be in one of two states (a binary), a qubit can exist in a linear combination of states known as a quantum superposition. The result of measuring a qubit is one of the two states, given by a probabilistic rule. If a quantum computer manipulates the qubit in a particular way, wave interference effects amplify the probability of the desired measurement result. Quantum algorithm design involves creating procedures that allow a quantum computer to perform this amplification.

=== Январь ===

1 января:
Болгария перешла на евро и стала 21-м членом Еврозоны.
Вступил в должность мэра Нью-Йорка сторонник партии Демократические социалисты Америки Зохран Мамдани.
Российские власти обвинили ВСУ в нанесении удара с помощью БПЛА по кафе в селе Хорлы, оккупированном Россией с 2022 в ходе вторжения в Украину, в результате чего погибло 27, в том числе ребёнок, и пострадало 50 человек, включая 6 несовершеннолетних. Источник в украинской армии заявил, что атака была направлена на собрание военных, которое было закрыто для гражданских. На 2 января российские власти опубликовали имена 12 погибших при ударе, как минимум трое из которых были связаны с российской оккупационной администрацией.
Пожар в Кран-Монтане. Погибли около 40 человек, 115 получили ранения.
2 января — Экваториальная Гвинея перенесла свою столицу из Малабо в Сьюдад-де-ла-Пас.
3 января — военная операция США в Венесуэле, в результате которого президент Николас Мадуро и его жена задержаны американскими властями. Обязанности президента взяла на себя вице-президент
